title: WikiPublishRequest
description: wiki.publish-request@1: bodies of wiki.revision.publish on OpenVibe.Wiki (editors). POST /api/v1/pages/:id/publish: { revision? } (default the head; an AI revision needs a person's approval first). POST /api/v1/pages/:id/schedule: { run_at, revision? } (ISO 8601). POST /api/v1/pages/:id/revisions/:n/review and POST /api/v1/proposals/:id/review: { decision: approved | rejected, note?, publish? } (a person; a proposal is published on approval unless publish is false). POST /api/v1/pages/:id/unpublish takes no body.
